page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8te.8xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured on KVM virtualization. The instance features 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor operating at 3.3 GHz. The compute subsystem is paired with 256 GB of system memory, providing an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. This balanced memory-to-core ratio allows execution of data-heavy intermediate pipelines alongside host CPU processing.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by two NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs delivering a cumulative total of 96 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. The instance does not bundle local storage, requiring persistent workloads to rely exclusively on remote block storage or cloud object storage volumes over the 32 Gbps baseline network interface. Network throughput supports rapid data transfer for remote assets, though operational deployment must account for zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The combination of dual Ada Lovelace GPUs with 96 GB total VRAM makes the instance architecturally geared toward graphics virtualization, deep learning inference, mid-sized model fine-tuning, and compute-intensive rendering workloads. While requiring external storage provisioning, the instance profile delivers high GPU compute density relative to host system resources, ensuring cost efficiency for specialized acceleration tasks that do not require local ephemeral scratch storage.
